posts.trend: Commute Times on Bengaluru’s SH-35 Corridor Surge 22% in Two Years, New Mobility Study Reveals
posts.context: The daily commute in major Indian IT corridors has become a gruelling part-time job that nobody is getting paid for.
posts.angle: Corporate systems track your laptop activity to the second, while ignoring the hours lost to absolute structural collapse outside the office gates.
slides: Your contract says 8 hours of work. It forgot to mention the 4 hours of tarmac.

Office reach time — up 22%.
Cab fare — up 40%.
Pothole depth — up 15 cm.
Your patience — depleted.

Your company counts the desk hours.

The road owns the rest.
posts.caption: Send this to the manager who insists on a 9 AM physical attendance huddle. 🚗
